page.layout: One page of running text in a single full-width column. No marginal notes. A catchword stands alone at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: conditionem esse putauerit, vt malo fato bo-norū nati, inprimis autem Galliæ, curent ex-stincta incendia, & tyrannidi Hispanę ministrent studiosissime. Sic ad piscatione turban-tur aquę sic ad commoditatem populationū miscentur incendia: quas artes ab Hispano regio hæc vestra vidit exercitas, & vestra ciuitas ingemuit συμπάθως[?]. Sed quia factū(quod aiunt) infectum esse non potest & alea à Bellarmino iacta est, quam suis illis tomis causam hac particularem indidit, quauis emortuam, ne in posteritatem moreretur (nempe interest Iesuiticę pietatis, vt semper in Christiano orbe exstent carbones & malleoli ad incendia publica paratissimi) hic mihi sextus labor ex confutatione appendicis illius adductus est; quā magnus ille disputator suis controversiarum tomis inferciuit: ex utroq; argumento pios lectores sperutilitatem[?], ex posteriore etiam voluptatem aliquam percepturos. Hunc vero sextum laborem meum V. A. nomini visum est inscribere, quia ita iubet ordo publicus florentissimæ regionis vestræ, postulant vestra in causam publicam merita, & me hoc decet facere, quia iam amplius decennium colonus sum patriæ huius vestrę; cui dum superest vita per Dei gratiam depędere statui hoc colonarium pro iure vestro & officio meo: prout jāaliis

page.notes: The Greek word after "ingemuit" is not clearly legible at this scan resolution; the reading συμπάθως is a guess. "sperutilitatem" (line 18) is a doubtful reading of a word damaged by blur and show-through. The first letter of "conditionem" at the top is partly obscured. The hyphenated "turban-tur" and "le-ctores" splits are printed as shown. The macron on "iā" is kept as printed.
